standard_prerequisites.name: Derived Hom colimit
standard_prerequisites.use: Presents Hom in D^b as a filtered colimit over quasi-isomorphisms.

core_obligations: Objects: isomorphism classes in D^b(A) are countable since every object is a bounded complex of a countable set.
Homs: Hom in K^b(A) between bounded complexes is countable; the colimit presentation makes Hom in D^b a countable colimit of countable sets.
proof_roadmap: Count objects, then count Homs through the colimit presentation.
difficulty_reason: Colimit presentation of Hom sets plus countability bookkeeping.
